says: The Comments unavailable state also changes what the filter does: Main.vb:427-429 (Commented filter) calls commentDict.ContainsKey on UserComments/CompComments with no Nothing guard, so with a Commented filter set and a source whose table is Nothing the check throws instead of treating the policy as uncommented (contrast GetPolicyComment at Main.vb:286-293, InspectSpolFragment.vb:11-13 and FindByText.vb:5, which all guard Nothing). Add this to the state's effect (a fact or in the state writtenAs) so the life says what unavailable does beyond the edit box and the save.
